turn.assistant_message:
Why is this scorecard needed? To objectively measure and improve customer support quality, ensuring consistent service that builds trust and loyalty. It helps identify performance gaps, guide agent training, and reduce customer churn by addressing critical touchpoints like response time, empathy, and resolution quality. Without it, quality assessment remains subjective and inconsistent across team members.

I've drafted the Customer Support Email Performance scorecard with your five KPIs and research-backed benchmarks: Response Time (25%, anchored to industry standard <1 hour for email), Resolution Quality (30%, the strongest driver of CSAT with 1:1 FCR-CSAT correlation), Empathy (18%), Clarity (15%), and Professionalism (12%). You didn't provide weights, so I allocated them based on research-backed impact: Resolution Quality gets the highest weight due to its direct link to customer satisfaction, while Professionalism remains essential but with fewer standalone benchmarks affecting final weight. All metrics now have concrete 0-10 thresholds drawn from industry benchmarks (e.g., world-class FCR at 80%+, email FRT under one hour). Let me know if you'd like to adjust anything.
